HediffDef.label: restoring archomechanites
HediffDef.description:
Advanced archomechanites restore the psycaster's body after injury. Their main flaw is that the colony of mechanites cannot safely rebuild living tissue while the host is under direct trauma stress, so the effect becomes dormant for a short time after the pawn takes damage.Can't resurrect the dead.

Healing: +200%

Bleeding wound repair: +145%

Blood loss recovery: +1.2% per sec.

Inactive after taking damage: 10 sec.

HediffDef.label: psy-blood
HediffDef.description: After countless psionic rites, this psycaster's blood has developed an unexpected property of homeostatic neural cooling, allowing the psycaster to remain in combat longer while drawing on their full potential.\n\nNeural heat reduction: -5/sec.
